title: Figure 15. Mode-5 Density-Function Values at Three Miles (Atlas IIAS)
description: Semi-log line graph of "Mode-5 Density-Function Value" (10^-5 to 10^-2) versus "Theta (deg)" (0 to 180) for five parameter pairs: A = 3.45/B = 1,000; A = 4.75/B = 50,000; A = 5.00/B = 100,000; A = 5.55/B = 500,000; and A = 6.30/B = 5,000,000. The curves fall steeply to about 60-100 degrees and then level off. Text below begins section 6.2.3, "Effects of Mode-5 Constants on Ship-Hit Contours."
